Name: OD's Krobus Shadow Fix
Author: ODMods
Description:
[size=6]OD's Krobus Shadow [/size]

Removes Krobus' shadow because he is one. Required in my OD's Junimo Krobus mod.
[size=5]
Installation[/size]

1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Install Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Launch the game via SMAPI.

[size=5]Contents[/size]

- `manifest.json`
- `content.json`
- `assets/`
[size=5]
Compatibility[/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- Content Patcher 2.4+

[size=5]Credits[/size]

Made by OD Mods.
